page.overview:
What is Deadlands?

The Deadlands is a fictional dimension in the Ash vs Evil Dead universe which first appeared in 2018 in the episode 7 of season 3, "Twist and Shout".

The Deadlands is the shadowy mirror version of the real world. Humans who have been killed by Deadites or other evil beings or objects, end up in the Deadlands where they are preyed upon by a shadow demon. It is to here that the Dark Ones were originally banished from Earth.
